blockers: No protected unseen holdout, repeated performance study, real user task, or cross-host verification.
Grader and executor share a model family; anonymized output can reveal its configuration.
Protocol and fixtures were frozen before execution, but their freeze was not independently timestamped or committed before the runs.

protocol.method: Each arm received identical synthetic task and no-tool instruction in a fresh ephemeral read-only session. Treatment received the skill and resources; baseline was not supplied them. Host skill discovery was disabled. Event records showed no tool calls.
protocol.grading: Separate fresh same-model graders received randomly labeled responses and frozen criteria. Configuration labels were withheld but could be inferred from response content. Pass evidence is a verified verbatim substring; absence is stated for failures. Complete responses and redacted event streams accompany the grades.
